profile.name: Tobi Joshua Samuel
profile.title: Founder & Lead Engineer
profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | AI & Agentic Systems Builder
profile.tagline: I build production software, AI-assisted systems, and digital products from idea to deployment — combining full-stack engineering, product architecture, automation, and agentic development workflows.
profile.summary: Founder & Lead Engineer at Expert Hive Technologies. Full-stack software engineer building platforms, AI-assisted systems, and agentic workflows across education, business operations, and production software.
about: I am a full-stack software engineer, founder, and product builder with several years of experience designing and deploying real-world software.
I founded Expert Hive Technologies to build technology and digital products that solve problems in education, business, professional services, and digital operations.

My work spans product architecture, backend engineering, APIs, frontend systems, databases, real-time applications, cloud deployment, internal business systems, automation, and AI-assisted development.

I increasingly work with agentic AI and AI-assisted engineering workflows, using tools such as Cursor and ChatGPT for implementation, debugging, testing, analysis, documentation, code review, research, and rapid product iteration — while maintaining engineering oversight and understanding the underlying systems.

I also have experience in AI training, data annotation, labeling, model-response evaluation, preference ranking, rubric-based evaluation, RLHF-related workflows, scientific coding evaluation, and quality assurance.
